The Thanos Depository#001.src: This is just a disaster... I pray nothing goes awry with the recovery team.
The Thanos Depository#001.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#002.src: I'd never be able to live it off if I'm responsible for more deaths.
The Thanos Depository#002.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#003.src: But I must do what it takes to prevent {p} from any more disaster.
The Thanos Depository#003.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#005.src: Atila, you're back! Give it to me straight, did they succeed? We can't afford any more losses.
The Thanos Depository#005.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#007.src: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble.
The Thanos Depository#007.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#008.src: So we truly do need to go through the vault. But with the defense systems gone haywire...
The Thanos Depository#008.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#010.src: Think nothing of it, let's get back to the drawing board.
The Thanos Depository#010.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#011.src: Yes, I'll get to it immediately.
The Thanos Depository#011.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#012.src: You there, human! What's your business here? Come speak to me.
The Thanos Depository#012.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#013.src: What's your business here? This place is off limits, the vault is very dangerous right now.
The Thanos Depository#013.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#014.src: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high-quality, yeah? What's your name?
The Thanos Depository#014.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#015.src: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're that guy who defeated that Qira woman, yeah?
The Thanos Depository#015.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#016.src: ... where have I heard that name before... Oh, I remember! You're the one who helped resolve the whole Dogun thing, right?
The Thanos Depository#016.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#017.src: I see, I haven't seen you around before.
The Thanos Depository#017.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#018.src: Nevertheless, {p} is in danger. To put it simply, a dragon is living uninvited in our depository.
The Thanos Depository#018.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#019.src: Perhaps, you've seen its lair above our city. Normally she leaves us unharmed, but one day she suddenly made her way in to this vault.
The Thanos Depository#019.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#020.src: My great friend Atila has been leading a recon squad, he's discerned that she's nesting an egg.
The Thanos Depository#020.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#021.src: We've tried at our greatest expenses to steal the egg, and bring it back to her nest, so that maybe she would leave... But, as you've heard, it's not going well.
The Thanos Depository#021.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#022.src: I don't normally ask this of strangers, but we've run ourselves thin. Do you think you're up to help? I'll make sure it's all worth your trouble.
The Thanos Depository#022.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#023.src: So you'll help!? Thank you so much! I'll make sure it's worth every moment!
The Thanos Depository#023.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#024.src: You'll have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#024.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#025.src: Atila knows some of the inner workings of the vault. I bid you good luck and will be praying for your success. Your courage will inspire {p}.
The Thanos Depository#025.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#026.src: Oh, so it wasn't meant to be I suppose...
The Thanos Depository#026.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#027.src: Well, if we cross paths again, I'll always much appreciate your help... Back to the drawing board...
The Thanos Depository#027.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#030.src: Find a way through the depository.

The Thanos Depository#031.src: Ride the minecarts to get further in to the depository

The Thanos Depository#032.src: Steal Ozoth's egg and escape the depository.

The Thanos Depository#034.src: Oh-oh my gosh!! I took you for dead, and thought the dragon was sending me up a corpse!
The Thanos Depository#034.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#035.src: You really got it!? Hurry, then, the nest is up through this cave! Maybe {p} can finally be rid of its woes...
The Thanos Depository#035.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#036.src: Place Ozoth's egg back in her nest at [{~},-{~}].

The Thanos Depository#038.src: She's a beauty, isn't she? A monster though, nevertheless.
The Thanos Depository#038.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#039.src: {u}! Over here... Atila told me the news, I came as fast as I could!
The Thanos Depository#039.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#040.src: You're a hero, lad! With the dragon out of our city, {p} no longer has to live in fear.
The Thanos Depository#040.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#041.src: I've prepared your reward. The people of {p} will remember your contribution for years to come.
The Thanos Depository#041.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#000~1.src: Thank you again...soldier. For helping us make peace...
The Thanos Depository#000~1.dst: 다시 한번 고맙네...병사여. 우리가 평화를 이루도록 도와줘서...

The Thanos Depository#002~1.src: Please take a track controller before entering the rail line.
The Thanos Depository#002~1.dst: 선로에 들어가기 전에 궤도 조종기를 하나 가져가 주세요.

The Thanos Depository#011~1.src: The elevator leads right in to where the dragon lays. Without knowing when it's asleep, it's a gamble...
The Thanos Depository#011~1.dst: 그 승강기는 용이 누워 있는 곳으로 곧장 이어져. 언제 잠드는지 모르니, 도박이나 마찬가지지...
The Thanos Depository#011~1.speaker: Atila

The Thanos Depository#012~1.src: It's a great feat what you've accomplished. The dwarven defense system was thought to be impeccable. We'll need to rethink our security!
The Thanos Depository#012~1.dst: 당신은 정말 대단한 일을 해냈네. 드워프의 방어 체계는 완벽하다고 여겨졌지. 보안을 다시 생각해 봐야겠어!

The Thanos Depository#020~1.src: Now that I look, say, that gear of yours is pretty high quality, yeah? What's your name?
The Thanos Depository#020~1.dst: 다시 보니, 이봐, 자네 장비 꽤 고급이잖아? 이름이 뭔가?
The Thanos Depository#020~1.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#031~1.src: You have to go through this chamber behind me to reach the depository. Our only other way in is right where the dragon is...
The Thanos Depository#031~1.dst: 보관소에 가려면 내 뒤에 있는 이 방을 지나가야 해. 다른 입구는 딱 용이 있는 곳밖에 없거든...
The Thanos Depository#031~1.speaker: Coulmis

The Thanos Depository#032~1.src: The people of {p} have everlasting gratitude, soldier.
